invariants.rationale: The context is crucial for distributed processing and usually required to be non-null.
The instantTime should typically be a non-empty string to identify the commit instant.
The records list is expected to be supplied and non-null for insertion.
Insertion is a no-op if the records list is empty, so non-empty records is common.
The context parameter must be an instance of HoodieEngineContext as defined by the signature.
